objective: DOM-based XSS is reported as not tested by a response-only scan, never as absent
preconditions: the xss lab with VULN_DOM_XSS on
input: GET /dom, whose source is location.hash and whose sink is innerHTML
expected: notTestable, with the reason and the sinks observed — the brief requires tested coverage to be distinguishable from untested areas, and "no DOM XSS found" from a scan that cannot see the DOM is a claim the evidence does not support
detail: The page contains client-side sink(s) innerHTML and source(s) location.hash, which is grounds for a browser-driven scan of this page, not a finding.
